name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Refines Top Row and section navigation: uses a square logo-shadow picker, makes persistence truly viewport-fixed while preserving page flow, reuses and caches Top Row content across page switches, begins Top Row rendering before Jellyfin finishes home sections, matches native clickable section-title alignment and arrows, adds normal-sized listing art with an image-type picker, improves message appearance spacing, and makes every message marquee regardless of length.
